pages.title: Thornfield operations wiki
pages.body: Working pages for the shop, cafe, yard and design studio. Ask Colm for edit access.

pages.title: Cafe opening checklist
pages.body: Coffee machine on at 8:15 so it is hot by half past. Check the fridge log, put out the terrace chairs, unlock the toilets and switch the card reader on.

pages.title: Open day 2027 marshalling plan
pages.body: Two marshals at the main gate from 9:30. When the main car park is full, send cars to the paddock. Keep the yard gate shut all day.

pages.title: Booking a delivery van
pages.body: Vans are booked on the whiteboard in the office. Write your name and the time you expect to be back. Keys live in the key safe, not in the vans.

pages.title: Tunnel ventilation in hot weather
pages.body: Above 26 degrees open both doors and roll the side vents. Close them again by six unless Tomas says otherwise.

pages.title: First aid for visitors
pages.body: The first aid bag is behind the shop counter. Record every incident in the accident book, even small cuts, and tell the duty manager.

pages.title: Card terminal troubleshooting
pages.body: If the terminal says no connection, restart it by holding the red key. If that fails, use the spare in the office drawer.

pages.title: Asking for holiday
pages.body: Holiday requests go to your line manager at least two weeks ahead. Weekends from April to June are busy, so expect some to be refused.

pages.title: Bin and recycling collection days
pages.body: General waste goes on Tuesdays, cardboard on Thursdays. Green waste goes in the skip by the compost bays and is swapped when full.

pages.title: Photographing products for the website
pages.body: Use the white board in the potting shed, natural light, no flash. Name each file with the product and the date.

pages.title: Hosting a school visit
pages.body: Classes arrive at the side gate. Two adults stay with each group. The seed sowing activity takes forty minutes, and the children take their pots home.
